question: Which price and trial terms do 5 Euro Usenet (5eurousenet.com), I-Telligent (i-telligent.nl), Ngroups (ngroups.net) and Usenet.Pro (usenet.pro) publish? Their vendor pages read show no price: 5eurousenet.com names only a 7-day money-back guarantee, i-telligent.nl lists speed tiers with its price page answering 404, ngroups.net shows only an FAQ, usenet.pro shows features only.
why: usenet.org lists all four as providers (5 Euro Usenet about five euros a month, I-Telligent three speed plans, Ngroups three plans, Usenet.Pro eleven speed tiers) but the cheapest paid tier could not be quoted from a vendor page, so no record was drafted. The prices sit behind a script-loaded or sign-up checkout.
